# `schedule`

Object · HSDS v3.2.3 · tabular file `schedules.csv` · [online reference](https://docs.openreferral.org/en/latest/hsds/schema_reference.html#schedule)

> The details of when a service or location is open. Entries are RFC 5545 RRULES.

**Required:** `id`
